candidates.headline: Von Miller agrees to terms with Cowboys; 1-year deal per source
candidates.description: Veteran OLB Von Miller has agreed to terms with the Dallas Cowboys -- a source telling ESPN that it's a one-year deal.

candidates.headline: CB Keisean Nixon not guaranteed starting role with Packers
candidates.description: The deeper the Packers get into training camp, the more uncertain it is that Keisean Nixon will be one of their opening-day starting cornerbacks.

candidates.headline: 49ers' George Kittle eyes return to practice, opener in Australia
candidates.description: George Kittle, who suffered a torn Achilles in January, said he might be able to practice soon with the hope that he'll be ready for the 49ers' opener vs. the Rams.

candidates.headline: LT Ozzy Trapilo (knee) now eligible to practice with Bears
candidates.description: The Bears activated Ozzy Trapilo off the physically unable to perform list on Sunday, seven months after the left tackle ruptured his patellar tendon in the postseason.
